reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: mint_ctokens (public(package)) is called at market.move:285 and is an exported package function. Gate 2: attack path enters via the public user-facing deposit entry point — no trust_assumptions in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json covers this vector. Gate 3: reserve.move is explicitly in_scope. An attacker can trigger this via the deposit entry point by first seeding 1 unit to obtain the sole ctoken position and then inflating the exchange rate via borrow interest accrual, causing any victim who deposits fewer underlying atomic units than the current exchange rate to have their collateral permanently locked in the reserve while receiving 0 ctokens (confirmed by the TODO at L159 and missing mint_amount > 0 assertion), after which the attacker redeems the sole outstanding ctoken to capture the victim's locked funds. Severity HIGH is appropriate: direct fund loss for depositors, no privileged access required, and BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json lists no client_diversity cap.
